neighbours.label: a degree or quantity word closing a short comparative or elliptical phrase ('just as loud', 'explain more', 'see all')
fire: My little brother can shout just as loud as our dad.
The new model runs twice as fast as the old one.
Do you really want to hear more? I doubt it.
The kids wanted to eat more after the long hike.
Our neighbor's dog barks just as often as ours does.
She studied harder than anyone else in her class.
You can view all photos from the trip on the website.
Nobody worked as long as the night crew that week.
quiet: My little brother can shout at our dad when he is angry.
The new model runs on a different engine than the old one.
Do you really want to hear the story? I doubt it.
The kids wanted to eat pizza after the long hike.
Our neighbor's dog barks at the mail carrier every day.
She studied biology at the college in her town.
You can view the photos from the trip on the website.
Nobody worked on the night crew that week.

notes: card: tiny max (4.7), top peaks ' all', ' as', ' more', ' loud' plus Cyrillic fragments. Probe: 'just as loud' 0.80, 'explain more' 0.58, 'see all' 0.30
